SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, #{referenceDate}) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, #{referenceDate}) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, #{referenceDate}) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, #{referenceDate}) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50대' WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, c.birth_date, #{referenceDate}) >= 60 THEN '60대 이상' ELSE '기타' END AS ageGroup, SUM(dsb.qty * dsb.avg_purchase_price) AS purchaseAmount, COUNT(*) AS purchaseCount FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id
dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')
AND (a.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (dp.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%') OR dp.ticker LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%'))
AND dsb.last_purchase_date >= #{startDateTime} AND dsb.last_purchase_date <= #{endDateTime}
GROUP BY ageGroup ORDER BY ageGroup

SELECT dp.domestic_product_id AS domesticProductId, dp.ticker AS ticker, dp.name AS name, SUM(dsb.qty * dsb.avg_purchase_price) AS purchaseAmount, COUNT(*) AS purchaseCount FROM domestic_stock_balance dsb JOIN domestic_product dp ON dp.domestic_product_id = dsb.domestic_product_id JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dsb.account_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
dsb.status NOT IN ('SOLD_OUT', 'TERMINATED')
AND (a.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND (dp.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%') OR dp.ticker LIKE CONCAT('%', #{productName}, '%'))
AND dsb.last_purchase_date >= #{startDateTime} AND dsb.last_purchase_date <= #{endDateTime}
GROUP BY dp.domestic_product_id, dp.ticker, dp.name ORDER BY purchaseAmount DESC

SELECT COALESCE(a.benefit, 'UNCLASSIFIED') AS benefit, COUNT(*) AS accountCount FROM account a JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id
AND (a.account_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY benefit
